steps.name: Extract crate information
steps.run:
cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 | jq -r '"name=" + .packages[0].name' | tee -a $GITHUB_OUTPUT
cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 | jq -r '"version=" + .packages[0].version' | tee -a $GITHUB_OUTPUT
cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 | jq -r '"maintainer=" + .packages[0].authors[0]' | tee -a $GITHUB_OUTPUT
cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 | jq -r '"homepage=" + .packages[0].homepage' | tee -a $GITHUB_OUTPUT
cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 | jq -r '"msrv=" + .packages[0].rust_version' | tee -a $GITHUB_OUTPUT

run.expr:
format('# Figure out suffix of binary
EXE_suffix=""
case {0} in
  *-pc-windows-*) EXE_suffix=".exe" ;;
esac;

# Setup paths
BIN_NAME="{1}${{EXE_suffix}}"
BIN_PATH="target/{2}/release/${{BIN_NAME}}"

# Let subsequent steps know where to find the binary
echo "BIN_PATH=${{BIN_PATH}}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "BIN_NAME=${{BIN_NAME}}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
', matrix.job.target, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, matrix.job.target)

format('# test only library unit tests and binary for arm-type targets
unset CARGO_TEST_OPTIONS
unset CARGO_TEST_OPTIONS ; case {0} in arm-* | aarch64-*) CARGO_TEST_OPTIONS="--lib --bin {1}" ;; esac;
echo "CARGO_TEST_OPTIONS=${{CARGO_TEST_OPTIONS}}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
', matrix.job.target, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name)

format('if [[ {0} = windows-* ]]
then
  powershell.exe -command "$BUILD_CMD test --locked --target={1} {2}"
else
  $BUILD_CMD test --locked --target={3} {4}
fi
', matrix.job.os, matrix.job.target, steps.test-options.outputs.CARGO_TEST_OPTIONS, matrix.job.target, steps.test-options.outputs.CARGO_TEST_OPTIONS)

format('PKG_suffix=".tar.gz" ; case {0} in *-pc-windows-*) PKG_suffix=".zip" ;; esac;
PKG_BASENAME={1}-v{2}-{3}
PKG_NAME=${{PKG_BASENAME}}${{PKG_suffix}}
echo "PKG_NAME=${{PKG_NAME}}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

PKG_STAGING="{4}/package"
ARCHIVE_DIR="${{PKG_STAGING}}/${{PKG_BASENAME}}/"
mkdir -p "${{ARCHIVE_DIR}}"
mkdir -p "${{ARCHIVE_DIR}}/autocomplete"

# Binary
cp "{5}" "$ARCHIVE_DIR"

# README, LICENSE and CHANGELOG files
cp "README.md" "LICENSE-MIT" "LICENSE-APACHE" "CHANGELOG.md" "$ARCHIVE_DIR"

# Man page
cp ''target/{6}/release/build/{7}''-*/out/assets/manual/bat.1 "$ARCHIVE_DIR"

# Autocompletion files
cp ''target/{8}/release/build/{9}''-*/out/assets/completions/bat.bash "$ARCHIVE_DIR/autocomplete/{10}.bash"
cp ''target/{11}/release/build/{12}''-*/out/assets/completions/bat.fish "$ARCHIVE_DIR/autocomplete/{13}.fish"
cp ''target/{14}/release/build/{15}''-*/out/assets/completions/_bat.ps1 "$ARCHIVE_DIR/autocomplete/_{16}.ps1"
cp ''target/{17}/release/build/{18}''-*/out/assets/completions/bat.zsh "$ARCHIVE_DIR/autocomplete/{19}.zsh"

# base compressed package
pushd "${{PKG_STAGING}}/" >/dev/null
case {20} in
  *-pc-windows-*) 7z -y a "${{PKG_NAME}}" "${{PKG_BASENAME}}"/* | tail -2 ;;
  *) tar czf "${{PKG_NAME}}" "${{PKG_BASENAME}}"/* ;;
esac;
popd >/dev/null

# Let subsequent steps know where to find the compressed package
echo "PKG_PATH=${{PKG_STAGING}}/${{PKG_NAME}}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
', matrix.job.target, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.version, matrix.job.target, env.CICD_INTERMEDIATES_DIR, steps.bin.outputs.BIN_PATH, matrix.job.target, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, matrix.job.target, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, matrix.job.target, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, matrix.job.target, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, matrix.job.target, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, matrix.job.target)

format('COPYRIGHT_YEARS="2018 - "$(date "+%Y")
DPKG_STAGING="{0}/debian-package"
DPKG_DIR="${{DPKG_STAGING}}/dpkg"
mkdir -p "${{DPKG_DIR}}"

DPKG_BASENAME={1}
DPKG_CONFLICTS={2}-musl
case {3} in *-musl*) DPKG_BASENAME={4}-musl ; DPKG_CONFLICTS={5} ;; esac;
DPKG_VERSION={6}
DPKG_ARCH="{7}"
DPKG_NAME="${{DPKG_BASENAME}}_${{DPKG_VERSION}}_${{DPKG_ARCH}}.deb"
echo "DPKG_NAME=${{DPKG_NAME}}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

# Binary
install -Dm755 "{8}" "${{DPKG_DIR}}/usr/bin/{9}"

# Man page
install -Dm644 ''target/{10}/release/build/{11}''-*/out/assets/manual/bat.1 "${{DPKG_DIR}}/usr/share/man/man1/{12}.1"
gzip -n --best "${{DPKG_DIR}}/usr/share/man/man1/{13}.1"

# Autocompletion files
install -Dm644 ''target/{14}/release/build/{15}''-*/out/assets/completions/bat.bash "${{DPKG_DIR}}/usr/share/bash-completion/completions/{16}"
install -Dm644 ''target/{17}/release/build/{18}''-*/out/assets/completions/bat.fish "${{DPKG_DIR}}/usr/share/fish/vendor_completions.d/{19}.fish"
install -Dm644 ''target/{20}/release/build/{21}''-*/out/assets/completions/bat.zsh "${{DPKG_DIR}}/usr/share/zsh/vendor-completions/_{22}"

# README and LICENSE
install -Dm644 "README.md" "${{DPKG_DIR}}/usr/share/doc/${{DPKG_BASENAME}}/README.md"
install -Dm644 "LICENSE-MIT" "${{DPKG_DIR}}/usr/share/doc/${{DPKG_BASENAME}}/LICENSE-MIT"
install -Dm644 "LICENSE-APACHE" "${{DPKG_DIR}}/usr/share/doc/${{DPKG_BASENAME}}/LICENSE-APACHE"
install -Dm644 "CHANGELOG.md" "${{DPKG_DIR}}/usr/share/doc/${{DPKG_BASENAME}}/changelog"
gzip -n --best "${{DPKG_DIR}}/usr/share/doc/${{DPKG_BASENAME}}/changelog"

cat > "${{DPKG_DIR}}/usr/share/doc/${{DPKG_BASENAME}}/copyright" <<EOF
Format: http://www.debian.org/doc/packaging-manuals/copyright-format/1.0/
Upstream-Name: {23}

EOF
  chmod 644 "${{DPKG_DIR}}/usr/share/doc/${{DPKG_BASENAME}}/copyright"

  # control file
  mkdir -p "${{DPKG_DIR}}/DEBIAN"
  cat > "${{DPKG_DIR}}/DEBIAN/control" <<EOF
Package: ${{DPKG_BASENAME}}
Version: ${{DPKG_VERSION}}
Section: utils
Priority: optional
Maintainer: {27}
Homepage: {28}
Architecture: ${{DPKG_ARCH}}
Provides: {29}
Conflicts: ${{DPKG_CONFLICTS}}
Description: cat(1) clone with wings.
  A cat(1) clone with syntax highlighting and Git integration.
EOF

DPKG_PATH="${{DPKG_STAGING}}/${{DPKG_NAME}}"
echo "DPKG_PATH=${{DPKG_PATH}}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

# build dpkg
fakeroot dpkg-deb --build "${{DPKG_DIR}}" "${{DPKG_PATH}}"
', env.CICD_INTERMEDIATES_DIR, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, matrix.job.target, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.version, matrix.job.dpkg_arch, steps.bin.outputs.BIN_PATH, steps.bin.outputs.BIN_NAME, matrix.job.target, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, matrix.job.target, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, matrix.job.target, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, matrix.job.target, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.homepage, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.maintainer, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.maintainer, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.maintainer, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.homepage, needs.crate_metadata.outputs.name)
